items.title: Windows Shell Security Feature 0-Day Vulnerability Let Attackers Bypass Authentication
items.description: Microsoft released Microsoft Patch Tuesday updates to address a critical zero-day vulnerability in Windows Shell that is currently being actively exploited in the wild. Tracked as CVE-2026-21510, this security flaw allows remote attackers to bypass essential protection mechanisms, putting millions of Windows users at risk. items.title: GitLab Patches Multiple Vulnerabilities That Enables DoS and Cross-site Scripting Attacks
items.description: A critical security update has been released for both the Community Edition (CE) and Enterprise Edition (EE) to address multiple high-severity vulnerabilities.
